field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Carries the three mandated GGUF model identities from cached SOTA receipts.
field_principles.attack:cache_resurrection: Stale cache state must not revive writes.
field_principles.attack:future_leakage: Future labels must not affect proposals or writes.
field_principles.attack:hidden_retuning: Held outcomes must not change the capacity or policy.
field_principles.attack:interrupted_persistence: Interrupted persistence must not promote a new head.
field_principles.attack:model_swaps: Model ids and bytes must match sealed receipts.
field_principles.attack:protected_leakage: Protected rows must not leak into held selection.
field_principles.attack:raw_output_reuse: Raw-output reuse must not release or promote memory.
field_principles.attack:rollback_omission: Rollback omission must not leave contamination.
field_principles.attack:same_step_writes: Writes must not occur in the same step as proposal generation.
field_principles.attack:stale_or_substituted_heads: Head substitution must fail persisted-head verification.
field_principles.attack:superseded_evidence: Superseded evidence must fail unless exact newer support exists.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Shows all critical attacks fail closed.
field_principles.autotokenizer_usage_count: Must remain zero because GGUF tokenizer metadata is embedded.
field_principles.cache_resurrection_count: Must be zero because stale caches cannot revive memory.
field_principles.cached_sota_pair_receipts: Records the helper calls that supplied all mandated model ids.
field_principles.delta:future_exact_yield: Selected-capacity future exact yield must exceed frozen.
field_principles.delta:negative_transfer: Negative transfer must stay within the preregistered bound.
field_principles.duration_s: Records measured wall time without padding.
field_principles.effective_sample_sizes_and_uncertainty: Reports counts, confidence intervals, nulls, and underpowered strata.
field_principles.exp6430_and_exp6431_gate_receipts: Pins the clean stream gate, the interference safety gate, and the Exp6420 failure context.
field_principles.field_principles: Documents why each artifact field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to sources, rows, reductions, checks, attacks, or tests.
field_principles.frozen_memory_policy_capacity_checker_mo: Freezes the Exp6430 policy, selected capacity, exact checkers, model bytes, prompts, and persisted head before held outcomes.
field_principles.gate:exp6420_failure_context: Exp6420 must keep raw-output reuse and cache resurrection defects visible.
field_principles.gate:exp6430_clean_stream: Exp6430 must be complete, ready, row-recomputed, and cache-clean.
field_principles.gate:exp6431_interference_safety: Exp6431 must be complete, ready, and contamination-clean.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Keeps weak, missing, null, and flagged cells visible.
field_principles.held:fresh_manifest: Held manifest and raw-output paths must be absent before generation.
field_principles.held:new_prompts: Held prompts must be new and bound to the planning date.
field_principles.held:unique_raw_outputs: Held raw-output hashes must be unique and absent from Exp6430 raw hashes.
field_principles.held_manifest_and_raw_output_path_absenc: Proves held manifest, artifact, and raw-output paths were absent before generation.
field_principles.held_manifest_path_hash_counts_balance_s: Seals held event order, balance, shift, restarts, expiry, supersession, and untouched evaluation rows.
field_principles.held_shift_restart_csl_ready_score: Conjunctive readiness score for held-shift restart replication.
field_principles.hidden_retuning_count: Must be zero because the policy is frozen before held exposure.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Uses a terminal success prefix and states the held-shift result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares task-scoped local GGUF held generation with exact-governed persisted memory.
field_principles.model_file_and_embedded_tokenizer_hashes: Binds model bytes, bytes-in-use counts, and embedded tokenizer metadata.
field_principles.models_used: Lists only the three mandated GGUF models used for held rows.
field_principles.negative_transfer_delta: Must stay at or below the preregistered harm bound.
field_principles.per_arm_model_family_session_coverage_pr: Reports separated arm, model-family, and session cells without development pooling.
field_principles.per_event_unique_raw_output_and_pre_outc: Proves each held event has one raw output and a proposal frozen before outcome release.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Records one matched frozen or selected-capacity row before aggregate calculation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Lists gates, GPUs, VRAM, model bytes, tokenizers, runner, helpers, policy, checkers, licenses, disk, path absence, and protected rows.
field_principles.process_restart_and_persisted_head_recov: Proves each held session recovered the persisted Exp6430 head from disk in a new process.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows protected upstream and ops files stayed byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_leakage_count: Must be zero because protected and future labels cannot route writes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins held events, sessions, prompts, restarts, attacks, and reductions.
field_principles.raw_output_reuse_count: Must be zero because one raw output cannot represent two held event ids.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_deltas: Shows reported aggregates match row recomputation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the artifact with volatile fields normalized.
field_principles.status: Names the terminal state for the held-shift process-restart replication.
field_principles.task_scoped_process_gpu_runner_and_raw_o: Binds fresh held generation to task-scoped process, GPU, runner, and raw-output receipts.
field_principles.tests_run: Records verification commands and exit codes.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Marks only exact feedback, persistence integrity, release, and protected-retention checks as oracles.
